Application Materials.content:
- Referees must submit their forms of reference via the hyperlink provided in the email invitation with the subject “Request for Statement of Reference” before the upcoming application deadline. **At least one of them must be an academic referee** from the university that you have graduated or will graduate from. The academic referee(s) is required to provide an official profile or directory link from the university website when completing the form of reference; form of reference without this profile or directory link will be considered incomplete, and the application will **NOT** be further processed.
- Upload the following supporting documents to the HKU Business School TPG Application Document Upload System no later than **TWO working days after the application deadline** of the round you are applying to. If there are further updates, upload a full set of the updated documents under that category; the new submission will overwrite the previous submission.
- CV.
- Academic Certificate: graduate transcript / latest official transcript; graduation certificate / Online Verification Report of Higher Education Qualification Certificate, applicable to candidates from Mainland China institutions only; Bachelor’s degree certificate / Online Verification Report of Higher Education Degree Certificate, applicable to candidates from Mainland China institutions only; official ranking certificate, **in ONE single PDF file**. Documents not in English should be accompanied by a formally certified English translation. Both Chinese and English versions are required for the online verification reports, and the validity period should be set to 6 months or the longest available.
- Working Experience Proof: valid employment proof of internship of all positions, or most recent full-time employment, whichever is applicable; contract/correspondences with working colleagues are not accepted as employment proof, **in ONE single PDF file**.
- Language Report, **in ONE single PDF file**.
- Photo Identification: passport page with photo / ID Card / Exit-Entry Permit, etc., **in ONE single PDF file**.
- Others: personal statement; GMAT/GRE score report; certificates of professional qualifications e.g. ACCA, CFA, CPA; etc., **in ONE single PDF file**.
- GMAT Code for Master of Science in Business Analytics: **FS2-WL-82**. GRE Code HKU: **2482**.
- You may be invited to record and upload admission videos as additional mandatory supporting documents.
- Applications with missing supporting documents will be considered incomplete and will **NOT** be processed further. In the application stage, the original copy of supporting documents is **NOT** required; candidates only need to upload the softcopy. If admitted, candidates will be asked to submit the original / certified true copy of the documents.

Interview Requirements.content: In general, applicants are not required to attend an interview during the admissions process. You may be invited to record and upload additional mandatory admission videos.

Academic Requirements.content:
- We welcome applicants from **all fields**. However, applicants with a **strong background in both STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) and business skills** would have an advantage.
- The Boot Camp is optional and covers basic knowledge of **mathematics (calculus and linear algebra), statistics and programming (Python, R, and SQL)**; those without a pure quantitative background can build up essential competencies through the Boot Camp.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content:
- GMAT/GRE scores are **not required**, but a good GMAT/GRE score will be favourably considered and can be helpful for marginal cases.
- Applicants may upload GMAT/GRE score report under “Others” supporting documents.
- GMAT Code for **Master of Science in Business Analytics**: **FS2-WL-82**.
- GRE Code for HKU: **2482**.
- GMAT score reports are valid for **five years**. Please make sure you arrange to get the official test report to us in time as the test authorities may not issue your report when the test result has expired.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
- Applicants to the Masters Programmes must obtain a TOEFL/IELTS score if they are not from an English-medium university.
- Minimum score requirement: TOEFL (Internet-based): **a score of 80 or above for tests taken before 21 January 2026; or a score of 4.5 or above for tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards**.
- IELTS: **6 (with no subtest below 5.5)**.
- IELTS and TOEFL tests must be taken within **two years prior to September 1 of each admissions year**. The test score reports are valid for **two years only**.
- TOEFL iBT Home Edition and IELTS One Skill Retake will not be accepted.
- Language Report upload instruction: IELTS and TOEFL tests must be taken within two years prior to September 1 of each admissions year, if you are not from an English-medium university. TOEFL iBT Home Edition and IELTS One Skill Retake will not be accepted. *TOEFL code of HKU: 9671; School Type: 01-Graduate; Department: 82-Business and Commerce*.

Program Overview.content:
The Master of Science in Business Analytics programme at HKU Business School offers a comprehensive curriculum that aims to help students develop both hard and soft skills related to business analytics throughout the programme. Students learn the knowledge and skills of understanding data, transforming data into information and converting information into executable actions. The school offers an extensive range of elective options to allow students to proceed in many specific focus areas.
The programme boasts a real world business analytics project - The Capstone Project - with reputable corporations in the region, in which students apply newly-learned analytics knowledge and skills to a real-life business problem facing project sponsors. Students form a team and apply analytics knowledge and skills learnt in previous courses to solve a real-life business problem facing project sponsors. The programme has collaborated with over 30 companies or government agencies in the past three years’ capstone projects.
The curriculum is structured as follows:
- Information analytics to understand the basis of data
- General analytics to transform data into information
- Operations analytics to convert information into executable actions
- Capstone Course to tie the above three areas together through real world business projects
Students gain an in-depth knowledge of tools such as R and Python for applying data science and analytics to a business context. The Programme offers two streams: 1) Artificial Intelligence (AI), 2) Management Consulting (MC). Students may choose to concentrate in one of the two streams according to their interests and career aspirations. Students may also choose to graduate without concentration provided that they complete the four fundamental core courses, the capstone course and five electives.
With the help of close ties to the industry, the MSc(BA) programme launched the Business Analytics Industry Seminar Series, which aims to make the programme more industry and career oriented.
Class profile: the programme recruits students from diverse backgrounds each year to enrich students’ learning experience. The class profile shows 63% female and 37% male students, average age 22, and 97% with prior internship experience, with 3 months average internship duration. Previous employers include Agricultural Bank of China, American International Group, Bank of China, Bank of East Asia, Boston Consulting Group, ByteDance, CITIC Securities, Hang Seng Bank Limited, Huawei, Ipsos China, and State Power Investment Corporation Group.
Programme faculty include Prof. Liao Wang, MSc(BA) Programme Director, along with faculty such as Prof. Boris BABIC, Prof. Zhanrui CAI, Prof. Michael C.L. CHAU, Prof. Hailiang CHEN, Prof. Xing HU, Prof. Shan HUANG, Prof. Zhenhui Jack JIANG, Prof. Xiao LEI, Prof. Xin TONG, Prof. Lionel Zhepeng LI, Prof. Haipeng SHEN, Prof. Tuan Quang PHAN, Prof. Benjamin YEN, Prof. Wei ZHANG, Prof. Yulin FANG, and Prof. Yifan YU.

Curriculum.content:
Students are required to complete a total of **10 courses**. The curriculum is structured as follows:
- Information analytics to understand the basis of data
- General analytics to transform data into information
- Operations analytics to convert information into executable actions
- Capstone Course to tie the above three areas together through real world business projects
The Programme offers two streams: **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and **Management Consulting (MC)**. Students may choose to concentrate in one of the two streams according to their interests and career aspirations. Students may also choose to graduate without concentration provided that they complete the four fundamental core courses, the capstone course and five electives.
The Boot Camp covers basic knowledge in mathematical techniques, programming, databases and statistics that are related to business analytics. The Boot Camp consists **36 hours** of teaching and will be held prior to the commencement of the 1st module:
- Consulting Fundamentals 1 & 2 (6 hours)
- Database – 3 hours
- Mathematics – 6 hours
- Programming – 15 hours
- Statistics – 6 hours
Core Courses:
- MSBA7001 Phthon for Data Analytics
- MSBA7002 Business Statistics
- MSBA7003 Decision Analytics
- MSBA7004 Operations Analytics
Course exemption of up to two required courses may be granted, except for the capstone course. No credits will be given for the exempted course and candidates shall be required to take an approved alternative course of the same credit value.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stream: Students who choose to graduate with the Artificial Intelligence (AI) stream are required to take a minimum of 1 course from AI Methods electives and a minimum of 1 course from AI Applications electives.
AI Methods Electives (Minimum 1):
- MSBA7028 Deep Learning
- MSBA7013 Forecasting and Predictive Analytics
- MSBA7027 Machine Learning
- MSBA7021 Optimization and Reinforcement Learning
AI Applications Electives (Minimum 1):
- MSBA7035 Applied Large Language Models
- MSBA7026 Big Data Analytics on the Cloud
- MSBA7036 Ethics in Artificial Intelligence
- MSBA7033 Generative Artificial Intelligence
- MSBA7032 Quantitative Trading
Management Consulting (MC) Stream: Students who choose to graduate with the Management Consulting (MC) stream are required to take a minimum of 1 course from Analytical Methods electives and a minimum of 1 course from Domain Expertise electives.
Analytical Methods Electives (Minimum 1):
- MSBA7037 A/B Testing in Product Management
- MSBA7014 Business Simulation
- MSBA7024 Database Design and Management
- MSBA7025 Digital Experimentation Methods
- MSBA7023 Geospatial and Business Analytics
- MSBA7027 Machine Learning
- MSBA7015 Service Operations Management
- MSBA7029 Storytelling with Data
Domain Expertise Electives (Minimum 1):
- MSBA7030 Digital Innovation
- MSBA7017 Financial Engineering
- MSBA7012 Social Media and Digital Marketing Analytics
- MSBA7016 Supply Chain and Logistics Management
Other Electives from MSc(BA) Programme:
- MSBA7020 Accounting Analytics for Managerial Decisions
- MSBA7041 Artificial Intelligence Generated Content in Business
- MSBA7034 International Study Field Trip
- MSBA7040 Sports Analytics
Other Masters Programmes: You can take up to two electives from the Master of Accounting, Master of Accounting Analytics, Master of Artificial Intelligence in Business, Master of Economics, Master of Finance, Master of Finance in Financial Technology, Master of Global Management, Master of Science in Marketing, Master of Sustainable Accounting and Finance or Master of Wealth Management programme at HKU. Enrollment in electives from other programmes is subject to seat availability and approval by the Programme Directors concerned based on your profile, capabilities and performance in the MSc(BA) programme. It is your responsibility to make sure you obtain **60 credits** to fulfill the graduation requirements and there is no overlapping of classes and exams in courses from different programmes. Up to two electives may be chosen from other taught postgraduate curricula offered by HKU Business School under the advice and approval of the Programme Directors concerned.
Capstone Course (Choose One):
- MSBA7005 Business Analytics Capstone
- PMSC7901 Business Case Analysis Capstone
Remark: Not all the courses listed will necessarily be offered each academic year and the listed courses are subject to further adjustments.

Cost of Attendance.content:
For HKU postgraduate students, estimated living-related costs include:
| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| Books and supplies (excluding personal computers & accessories) | Around $11,440-$55,600 p.a. |
| University's residential halls & colleges lodging fees | $27,000 - $92,000 p.a. |
| CEDARS-administered non-hall housing lodging fees | $20,000 p.a. - $120,000 p.a. |
| Food, groceries, transportation and others | Around $6,100 per month up (depending on your lifestyles and if you go grocery shopping around the campus) |
**Estimated Cost of Living Outside Campus by Month (Per Person) for reference only**: All figures are estimates for 2026/27 and subject to inflation and lifestyle.
| Item | HKD |
| --- | --- |
| Rent for Off-Campus Accommodation (depending on the size, location and type of accommodation) | $8,000-20,000 |
| Utilities | $1,000 |
| Food | $6,000 |
| Local Transportation | $500 |
| Personal Miscellaneous | $1,500 |
| Total | $17,000-29,000 |
Other expenses to consider when renting outside campus include agent commission, typically **50% of one month's rent**; deposit, usually **2 months' rent**; stamp duty, around **$300** for a $10,000/month rental; and moving-in costs like furniture and household items. Meal expenses on campus are typically HK$25 - HK$65 per meal. For the first month, on top of tuition fees, expenses can amount to HK$10,000 or more for a student.

Financial Aid.content:
**HKU Business School Dean's Master Fellowship**: The Fellowship shall be awarded to new full-time students admitted to any one of the taught postgraduate programmes offered by the HKU Business School based on academic performance, relevance of work experience, if applicable, and interview performance, if applicable. The value of the Fellowship ranges from **HK$250,000 to the full prevailing composition fee**. All eligible candidates are automatically considered; no separate application is required except for the Master of Family Wealth Management (MFWM) programme. Outstanding students will only be awarded either the Entrance Scholarship or the Dean's Master Fellowship; the scholarship and fellowship will not be issued to the same candidate.
**Entrance Scholarship**: Scholarships are offered to qualified students, who may receive a scholarship ranging from **5% to 50%** in most cases, on the basis of student's academic merit at the time of admission. A full tuition fee waiver may be offered to outstanding cases. All eligible candidates are automatically considered; no separate application is required except for the Master of Family Wealth Management (MFWM) programme.
**Merit-based Scholarship**: Merit-based scholarships are offered to qualified students, who shall receive a scholarship of **10%**, on the basis of student's performance, including but not limited to, academic performance of the first three modules, participation in the extra-curricular activities, recommendation from course instructors, and level of support provided to the programme office. All eligible candidates are automatically considered; no separate application is required.
**Fargo Wealth Excellence Scholarship**: Up to fourteen scholarships shall be awarded each year to full-time Year One students of Master of Science in Business Analytics, among other listed programmes, on the basis of academic performance in the respective programme and contributions to the community of the respective masters programme. The Scholarship shall be of the value of **HK$10,000** each.
**Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship Scheme for Advanced Studies**: Starting from the 2025-26 academic year, the Government is introducing the Hong Kong Future Talents Scholarship Scheme for Advanced Studies (HKFTSS). Master of Science in Business Analytics is eligible for FTSS in the 2026 intake. Applications are open to local students admitted to the programmes listed above in the 2026 intake; scholarship awards will be based on merit taking into account students' academic achievements, professional qualifications, relevant work experience and achievements in other areas as well as the proposals submitted by the students; applications from students who are receiving other forms of government scholarship (except student financial assistance) for pursuing the same programme will not be considered. All awardees must sign a written undertaking that upon graduation they will contribute to relevant industries/sectors through full-time employment or entrepreneurial activities either in Hong Kong or within the Greater Bay Area. HKFTSS scholarship is capped at **HK$100,000** for each student for the whole TPg programme, regardless of the actual study period and mode of study. Awardees are required to pay a minimum tuition fee being the prevailing rate of UGC-funded full-time degree programmes, i.e. **HK$47,000 for 2026-2027 academic year**.
**Continuing Education Fund (CEF)**: There are currently 3 courses in HKU MSc(BA) that are listed as a reimbursement course under the Continuing Education Fund (CEF) scheme, which provides a maximum of **HK$25,000** in reimbursement to those who fulfil the criteria. Eligible MSc(BA) courses: 1. Financial Engineering 2. Service Operations Management 3. Social Media and Digital Marketing Analytics. Please visit the CEF website for further details: http://www.wfsfaa.gov.hk/cef/en/index.htm

Multiple Applications.content: Yes, it is possible for you to apply to multiple programmes at HKU. You can apply under different usernames on the application system and pay the application fee (HK$600) for each programme that you wish to apply to. You can only enrol in one programme, even if you receive offers from other programmes.

Deferral Admission Policy.content: **Admission deferrals are not possible** and you are required to re-apply for admission for the next year.

Conditional Admission Policy.content: Students are recommended to start the student visa application once they have received a **conditional offer**. Students with a **Conditional Admission Offer from HKU Business School** may apply for entry for study even without a Firm Admission Offer. However, upon receipt of the **Firm Admission Offer**, they are required to upload a copy of the Firm Offer to the [HKU Student Visa Application System](https://studentvisaapp.hku.hk/login). Otherwise, the Admissions Office will not issue the approved visa/entry permit.
